# 

# **Description**

# This circuit is a switch-based **AND gate**. It connects a **DC battery**, two switches (**SW1** and **SW2**) in series, an **LED (D1)**, and a **resistor** in a single loop. The LED lights up only when **both switches are closed** at the same time.

# **Materials Required**

* # **DC Battery** (power source)![][image1]

* # **2 Switches** (**SW1** and **SW2**)

* # **1 LED** (**D1**)

* # **1 Resistor** (protects the LED)

* # **Connecting wires** and a **soldering board** (perfboard)

# ---

### **Procedure**

1. # **Place Parts**: Push the switches, LED, and resistor into your circuit board.

2. # **Solder Connections**: Solder a wire from the battery positive terminal to **SW1**, **SW1** to **SW2**, **SW2** to the LED (+), and the LED (-) to the resistor.

3. # **Complete the Loop**: Solder the other end of the resistor back to the battery negative terminal![][image2]

4. # **Test**: Connect power to **both switches together**  and  turn on the ligpressht![https://github.com/kavyavenkat29/AND-GATE-CIRCUIT-/blob/main/Truth%20table.jpg][image3] t.

# **![https://github.com/kavyavenkat29/AND-GATE-CIRCUIT-/blob/main/AND%20Gate%20.jpg][image4]**
# **![https://github.com/kavyavenkat29/AND-GATE-CIRCUIT-/blob/main/IMG-20260921-WA0014.jpg][image5]**

# **Notes**

* # **Use a Resistor**: Prevents the LED from burning out due to too much current.

* # **LED Direction**: The longer leg of the LED is positive (+) and must point toward the switches.

* # **Soldering Care**: Solder in a well-ventilated room and wear eye protection.

# ---

##### **It Is UsedWhere  in Real Life**

* # **Machine Safety Controls**: Heavy machinery that requires pressing two buttons at once so hands stay clear of danger.

* # **Car Ignitions**: Cars that start only when you turn the key **AND** press the brake.

* # **High-Security Doors**: Locks that require a card swipe **AND** a fingerprint scan to open.
